page0.text:
...Maybe I should spend some time alone.
There is still time.
If I go back to the beginning and think about everything that has happened in the Holy Grail War until now, I'm sure something akin to that Servant's weakness would come up...

page2.text:
"...I can't believe I fell asleep."
Not able to think of anything, I fell asleep the moment my body hit the floor. It's probably because of the fatigue I've been building up.
I fell asleep almost immediately. When I wake up it's already...

page3.text:
"...Phew, it's not that bad, not even 1AM yet. I only slept for thirty minutes."
I for sure thought I would've overslept. I feel embarassed just thinking how Tohsaka would violently wake me up and give me a scolding.

page4.text:
"That was close... I can't let Tohsaka see me like this even by mista—"
"...Shirou, are you awake?"
"...T-T-Tohsaka!?"

page5.text: I jumped up thinking my heart was about to burst out.

page6.text:
"I-I'm awake, just so you know!"
I answer her as I'm trying to clean myself up.

page7.text:
"Is that so? Well then can you come to my room? I need to talk to you."
...And that's it.
Tohsaka didn't realize I dozed off for a bit and went back to her room.
"...?"
I don't know what she wants to talk about, but I should head there soon.

page8.text:
"I'm coming in, Tohsaka. So, what do you want to talk about?"
"..."
What is up with her?
She's the one who called me here so why is she glaring at me?

page9.text:
"Tohsaka, are you in a really bad mood right now?"
I already know what she's going to say, but it doesn't hurt to ask.
"WHAT DO YOU THINK?"
She'd obviously yell at me, but I really am curious, so I end up asking her anyway.
However...

page10.text:
"...Never mind. It's not like I'm actually mad at you."
Well, now she's making me even more confused.

page11.text:
"Tohsaka, do you...have a fever or something?"
"No, I don't! ...Ugh, will you just sit down already!?
I will think of something to deal with Gilgamesh since you can't think of anything by yourself!"

page12.text: Tohsaka drags me inside the room and locks the door. Then she slowly moves back into the room.

page13.text:
"...?"
Anyway, I start to move toward the center of the room.
Facing toward Tohsaka, I sit down across from her.

page14.text:
...
...
And somehow we're both not saying a word, this feels awkward...

page15.text:
"Tohsaka, about Gilgamesh..."
"...I know. You're going to tell me you don't want to have Saber fight him, right? You're really considerate of her."

page16.text:
"Hold on, that's not what I'm talking about.
I'm simply saying that Gilgamesh is a bad match for Saber, so we should rethink our formation, that's all. If Saber is defeated and no one is left to slow him down, Tohsaka would be next."

page17.text:
"...I see. Well how do you propose we change our formation? I'm not going up against that Goldy.
He is taking advantage of his treasury and has anti-magecraft armor on.
He's a bad match for Saber, but an even worse match for me. Same for you."

page19.text:
...But I just can't forget those eyes.
What Archer's gaze was trying to tell me.
That golden Servant.
Only Shirou Emiya can go up against Gilgamesh.
